verses.text: Moto ya mayele amonaka likama na mosika mpe amibombaka,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo azangi mayele akoleka wana mpe akokutana na pasi.

verses.text: Komikitisa mpe kotosa Yawe ememaka

continuations.text: bozwi, lokumu mpe bomoi.

verses.text: Nzela ya bato mabe ezalaka na banzube mpe mitambo,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo abatelaka molimo na ye azalaka mosika na yango.

verses.text: Lakisa mwana nzela oyo asengeli kotambola wuta na bomwana na ye ;

continuations.text: ezala tango akokoma mokolo, akobunga yango te.

verses.text: Mozwi azalaka mokonzi ya mobola,

continuations.text: mpe modefi azalaka mowumbu ya modefisi.

verses.text: Moto oyo alonaka masumu abukaka pasi,

continuations.text: mpe makasi ya kanda na ye nyonso ekosuka.

verses.text: Moto oyo akabaka na esengo akopambolama,

continuations.text: pamba te akabolaka bilei na ye na mobola.

verses.text: Bengana motioli,

continuations.text: bongo kowelana, koswana mpe kofingana ekosila.

verses.text: Moto oyo alingaka kozala peto na motema,

continuations.text: oyo ngolu ezalaka na bibebu na ye,
mokonzi azalaka molingami na ye.

verses.text: Miso na Yawe ebatelaka boyebi,

continuations.text: kasi akweyisaka maloba ya moto oyo azangi mayele.

verses.text: Moto ya goyigoyi alobaka : « Nkosi ezali kuna na libanda,

continuations.text: ekoboma ngai na kati-kati ya balabala. »

verses.text: Monoko ya mwasi ya ndumba ezalaka lokola libulu ya mozindo ;

continuations.text: moto oyo Yawe asilikeli akweyaka kuna.

verses.text: Motema ya mwana moke ezalaka na bozoba,

continuations.text: bongo fimbu ya pamela elongolaka yango kati na ye.

verses.text: Moto oyo anyokolaka mobola

continuations.text: mpo ete akoma na bomengo mingi
mpe oyo apesaka mozwi bakado bakokweya na bobola.

verses.text: Pesa matoyi mpe yoka toli ya bato ya bwanya,

continuations.text: mpe tika ete motema na yo endima mateya na ngai.

verses.text: Pamba te ekozala esengo soki obombi yango na motema na yo,

continuations.text: mpe soki yango nyonso ezali pene ya bibebu na yo.

verses.text: Nateyi yo yango lelo

continuations.text: mpo ete elikya na yo ezala kati na Yawe.

verses.text: Boni, lobi eleki, nakomelaki yo te batoli koleka tuku misato,

continuations.text: batoli ya bwanya mpe ya boyebi,

verses.text: batoli oyo epesaka mateya ya solo

continuations.text: mpe maloba ya solo mpo ete okoka kozongisa biyano ya solo
na moto oyo atindi yo ?

verses.text: Kobotola te na makasi biloko ya mobola,

continuations.text: pamba te azali mobola,
konyokola te moto ya pasi na esambiselo,

verses.text: pamba te Yawe akobundela bango

continuations.text: mpe akobebisa bomoi ya bato
oyo bakobebisa bomoi na bango.

verses.text: Kozala molingami te ya moto ya kanda,

continuations.text: mpe kosangana te na moto ya motema moto-moto,

verses.text: noki te okoyekola nzela na ye

continuations.text: mpe okokangama na motambo na ye.

verses.text: Kozala te na molongo ya bato oyo batombolaka maboko

continuations.text: mpo na kondima kofuta baniongo ya bato mosusu,

verses.text: pamba te soki ozali na yo na makoki ya kofuta te,

continuations.text: mpo na nini okolinga ete babotola ata mbeto na yo ya kolala ?

verses.text: Kozongisa na sima te mondelo ya kala

continuations.text: oyo batata na yo bakataki.

verses.text: Osila komona moto oyo ayebi mosala na ye malamu ?

continuations.text: Akosala kaka liboso ya bakonzi,
akosala te liboso ya bato ya molili.

verses.text: Soki ovandi mpo na kolia mesa moko elongo na mokonzi,

continuations.text: tala malamu moto oyo azali liboso na yo.

verses.text: Tia mbeli na mongongo na yo

continuations.text: soki ozalaka lokoso.

verses.text: Kolula te bilei na ye ya kitoko,

continuations.text: pamba te, tango mosusu, ezali na yango bololo.

verses.text: Koboma nzoto te mpo na koluka kozwa bomengo,

continuations.text: kotia mayele na yo te kati na yango.

verses.text: Tango okobwaka miso na ngambo ya bomengo, ekobunga,

continuations.text: pamba te ezalaka na mapapu
mpe epumbwaka na likolo makasi lokola mpongo.

verses.text: Kolia te bilei ya moto oyo azali kotala yo na miso mabe

continuations.text: mpe kolula te bilei na ye ya kitoko,

verses.text: pamba te azalaka ndenge makanisi ya motema na ye ezali.

continuations.text: Alobaka : « Lia mpe mela, »
kasi motema na ye ezali elongo na yo te.

verses.text: Okosanza eteni oyo oliaki,

continuations.text: mpe maloba na yo ya kitoko ekokende pamba.

verses.text: Kolobaka na zoba te,

continuations.text: pamba te akotiola bwanya ya maloba na yo.

verses.text: Kozongisa te na sima mondelo ya kala

continuations.text: mpe kokota te na bilanga ya bana bitike,

verses.text: pamba te Molobeli na bango azalaka makasi,

continuations.text: akozwa makambo na bango na maboko
mpo na kotelemela yo.

verses.text: Tika ete motema na yo endimaka kotosa mibeko,

continuations.text: mpe matoyi na yo eyokaka maloba ya boyebi !

verses.text: Kozangisa te kopesa mwana etumbu ;

continuations.text: soki obeti ye fimbu, akokufa te.

verses.text: Na kobeta ye fimbu,

continuations.text: okokangola molimo na ye na lifelo.

verses.text: Mwana na ngai, soki motema na yo ezali na bwanya,

continuations.text: motema na ngai ekozala na esengo.

verses.text: Solo, bomoto na ngai nyonso ekotonda na esengo,

continuations.text: soki bibebu na yo elobi makambo ya sembo.

verses.text: Tika ete motema na yo elulaka te bato ya masumu,

continuations.text: kasi zalaka tango nyonso na posa makasi ya kotosa Yawe ;

verses.text: pamba te suka na yo ekozala solo malamu

continuations.text: mpe elikya na yo ekozala ya pamba te.

verses.text: Mwana na ngai, yoka mpe zala na bwanya,

continuations.text: batela motema na yo kati na nzela ya sembo.

verses.text: Kozala esika moko te na balangwi masanga

continuations.text: to na bato ya lokoso,

verses.text: pamba te balangwi masanga mpe bato na lokoso bakomaka babola,

continuations.text: mpe bogoyigoyi ekolatisa bango bilamba epasuka.

verses.text: Yokela tata oyo aboti yo,

continuations.text: mpe kotiola mama na yo te ata soki anuni.

verses.text: Luka bosolo, kasi koteka yango te ;

continuations.text: sala se bongo na bwanya, na mateya mpe na mayele.

verses.text: Tata ya moto ya sembo akozala na esengo mingi,

continuations.text: mpe moto oyo abota mwana ya bwanya akosepela kati na ye.

verses.text: Tika ete tata na yo mpe mama na yo basepela !

continuations.text: Tika ete mama oyo abota yo azala na esengo !

verses.text: Mwana na ngai ya mobali, pesa ngai motema na yo,

continuations.text: mpe tika ete miso na yo esepela na nzela na ngai !

verses.text: Pamba te mwasi ya ndumba azali lokola libulu ya monene,

continuations.text: mpe mwasi ya mopaya azali lokola libulu ya mozindo.

verses.text: Mwasi ya ndumba atelemaka na ekenge lokola moyibi

continuations.text: mpe akomisaka mibali bazoba koleka.

verses.text: Mpo na nani : « Ah ngai, mawa ! »

continuations.text: Mpo na nani : « Eh ! »
Mpo na nani koswanaswana ?
Mpo na nani kolelalela ?
Mpo na nani kowelana ezanga tina ?
Mpo na nani kotelisa miso ?

verses.text: Mpo na bato oyo bawumelaka liboso ya masanga ya vino,

continuations.text: mpo na bato oyo bamelaka masanga ya makasi.

verses.text: Kotalaka te masanga ya vino tango ezali motane,

continuations.text: tango ezali kongala kati na kopo mpe kokita na pete na mongongo.

verses.text: Na suka na yango, ekoswa yo lokola nyoka

continuations.text: mpe ekotia yo minu lokola etupa.

verses.text: Miso na yo ekomona biloko na ndenge ya kokamwa,

continuations.text: mpe motema na yo ekobimisa makambo ya bozoba.

verses.text: Boye, okokoma lokola moto oyo alali kati na ebale monene,

continuations.text: mpe lokola moto oyo alali na songe ya nzete ya molayi.

verses.text: Okoloba : « Babeti ngai, kasi nazali koyoka pasi te ;

continuations.text: babeti ngai fimbu, kasi nazali koyoka eloko te !
Tango nini nakolamuka ?
Nakozongela lisusu komela vino. »

verses.text: Kolulaka te bato oyo basalaka mabe

continuations.text: mpe kolukaka te kozala elongo na bango,

verses.text: pamba te mitema na bango ekanisaka kaka kosala mabe,

continuations.text: mpe bibebu na bango eyeisaka kaka mobulu soki elobi.

verses.text: Ndako etongamaka na nzela ya bwanya,

continuations.text: mpe elendisamaka na nzela ya mayele.

verses.text: Bashambre ekotondisama na biloko nyonso

continuations.text: ya talo mpe ya kitoko na nzela ya boyebi.

verses.text: Moto ya bwanya atondi na nguya,

continuations.text: moto oyo azalaka na boyebi alendisaka nguya na ye.

verses.text: Pamba te kolonga na etumba esengaka bwanya,

continuations.text: mpe lobiko ezalaka kati na motango ebele ya bapesi toli.

verses.text: Bwanya ezalaka likolo mingi mpo na zoba,

continuations.text: yango wana azalaka te na likambo ya koloba
kati na mayangani oyo esalemaka pembeni ya ekuke.

verses.text: Moto oyo asalaka mabongisi ya kosala mabe

continuations.text: akokende sango lokola moteki baninga.

verses.text: Mabongisi ya bozoba ezali masumu,

continuations.text: mpe bato bayinaka motioli.

verses.text: Soki omilembisi na mokolo ya pasi,

continuations.text: makasi na yo ekozala pamba.

verses.text: Kangola bato oyo bazali komema bango na kufa,

continuations.text: mpe bikisa bato oyo bazali kokende na kufa
lokola bato oyo balangwe masanga.

verses.text: Soki olobi : « Tala, toyebaki likambo moko te

continuations.text: kati na makambo oyo nyonso ; »
boni, Ye oyo amekaka mitema asosolaka yango te ?
Ye oyo abatelaka molimo na yo ayebaka yango te ?
Afutaka te moto na moto kolanda misala na ye ?

verses.text: Mwana na ngai, lia mafuta ya nzoyi,

continuations.text: pamba te ezalaka kitoko !
Mwa ndambo ya mafuta ya nzoyi ekozala
elengi na lolemo na yo.

verses.text: Yeba lisusu ete bwanya ezali elengi

continuations.text: mpo na molimo na yo ;
soki ozwi yango, yeba ete lobi na yo ekozala malamu,
mpe elikya na yo ekozala ya pamba te.

verses.text: Yo moto mabe, komeka te kotia mitambo

continuations.text: kati na ndako ya moto ya sembo,
mpe komeka te kopanza yango,

verses.text: pamba te ata soki moto ya sembo akweyi mbala sambo,

continuations.text: akotelema kaka ;
nzokande pasi ekweyisaka moto mabe.

verses.text: Soki monguna na yo akweyi, kosepela te ;

continuations.text: mpe soki apengwi, tika ete motema na yo esepela te ;

verses.text: noki te Yawe akomona, akosepela te

continuations.text: mpe akokitisela yo kanda na Ye.

verses.text: Kosilika te likolo ya bato oyo basalaka mabe,

continuations.text: kolula te bato mabe ;

verses.text: pamba te lobi ya malamu ekozala te

continuations.text: mpo na moto oyo asalaka mabe,
mpe mwinda ya bato mabe ekokufa.

verses.text: Mwana na ngai, tosaka Yawe mpe mokonzi,

continuations.text: kosanganaka te na batomboki,

verses.text: pamba te bango mibale bakoki kotindela batomboki pasi na pwasa.

continuations.text: Bongo, nani ayebi pasi oyo bakoki kotinda ?

verses.text: Makambo oyo mpe ezali toli ya bato ya bwanya :
source_headings_before: Maloba mosusu ya bato ya bwanya

continuations.text: Kopona bilongi, kati na kosambisa, ezali malamu te.

verses.text: Moto oyo alobaka na moto mabe : « Ozali moto ya sembo, »

continuations.text: bato bakolakela ye mabe, mpe bikolo ekotombokela ye.

verses.text: Kasi bato oyo bapamelaka moto mabe bakozala malamu

continuations.text: mpe lipamboli ekozala likolo na bango.

verses.text: Eyano ya solo ezali lokola beze ya bibebu.
Bongisa libanda ya mosala na yo,

continuations.text: bongisa bilanga na yo,
bongo na sima, tonga ndako na yo.

verses.text: Kotatola na pamba te mpo na kosala moninga na yo mabe ;

continuations.text: mpo na nini olingi kosalela bibebu na yo na lokuta ?

verses.text: Kolobaka te : « Nakosala ye ndenge asali ngai,

continuations.text: nakozongisela ye kolanda makambo oyo ye asali. »

verses.text: Nalekaki pembeni ya elanga ya moto ya goyigoyi,

continuations.text: mpe pembeni ya elanga ya vino ya moto oyo azangi mayele ;

verses.text: bongo, tala ndenge etondi na banzube,

continuations.text: tala ndenge matiti mabe ezipi yango,
mpe mir na yango ya mabanga ebukani.

verses.text: Tango natiaki makanisi na ngai

continuations.text: kati na makambo oyo namonaki,
nazwaki mayele oyo :

verses.text: mwa pongi moke, mwa kopema moke,

continuations.text: mwa kokanga maboko moke mpo na kolala,

verses.text: bobola ekoyela yo na pwasa lokola moleki nzela,

continuations.text: mpe pasi ekoyela yo lokola moyibi.

verses.text: Tala masese mosusu ya Salomo oyo bato ya Ezekiasi, mokonzi ya Yuda, bakomaki.
Nzambe azwaka nkembo

continuations.text: mpo ete asalaka makambo oyo bato bayebaka te,
mpe bakonzi bazwaka nkembo
mpo ete balukaka kososola tina ya makambo.

verses.text: Ndenge bakokaka te komeka

continuations.text: bosanda ya Lola to bozindo ya mabele,
ndenge wana mpe bakoki te kososola mitema ya bakonzi.

verses.text: Soki olongoli mbindo na palata,

continuations.text: ekobimisa mbeki mpo na monyangwisi bibende na moto.

verses.text: Soki olongoli moto mabe liboso ya mokonzi,

continuations.text: kiti na ye ya bokonzi ekolendisama na bosembo.

verses.text: Komikumisaka te liboso ya mokonzi,

continuations.text: mpe komivandisaka te na esika ya bato minene ;

verses.text: pamba te eleki malamu ete baloba na yo : « Yaka kovanda na esika oyo ya lokumu, »

continuations.text: na esika ete bayokisa yo soni na miso ya mokonzi.

verses.text: Kowelaka te kokende kofunda epai ya basambisi

continuations.text: makambo oyo osili komona na miso,
pamba te okosala nini na suka
soki moninga na yo asukisi yo ?

verses.text: Soki ozali kowelana na moninga na yo,

continuations.text: kobimisa sekele ya moto mosusu te,

verses.text: noki te ayoka yango mpe ayokisa yo soni,

continuations.text: boye okosambwa mpo na libela.

verses.text: Liloba oyo elobami na tango oyo ekoki

continuations.text: ezali lokola wolo oyo basangisi na palata.

verses.text: Pamela ya moto ya bwanya epai ya moto oyo ayokaka

continuations.text: ezali lokola wolo ya peto mpe sheneti ya wolo.

verses.text: Motindami ya sembo azalaka

continuations.text: lokola mopepe ya malili ya mvula ya pembe
na tango ya kobuka bambuma,
asalaka esengo ya mokonzi na ye.

verses.text: Moto oyo amikumisaka ete akabaka,

continuations.text: nzokande apesaka na ye eloko te,
azali lokola mapata mpe mopepe oyo ezangi mvula.

verses.text: Moto oyo akangaka motema

continuations.text: akoki kobongola makanisi ya mokonzi,
mpe maloba ya malamu ebukaka mikuwa.

verses.text: Soki omoni mafuta ya nzoyi, lia oyo ekoki na yo,

continuations.text: pamba te soki olie yango na lokoso, okosanza yango.

verses.text: Kokendaka pamba-pamba te na ndako ya moninga na yo,

continuations.text: noki te akotonda yo mpe akolemba yo.

verses.text: Moto oyo apesaka matatoli ya lokuta

continuations.text: mpo na kosala moninga na ye mabe
azali lokola marto, mopanga mpe mbanzi ya songe.

verses.text: Kotia elikya na zoba na tango na pasi

continuations.text: ezali lokola lino ebukani mpe lokolo elembi.

verses.text: Koyembela moto oyo azali na mawa banzembo ya esengo

continuations.text: ezali lokola kolongola ye kazaka na tango ya malili
to kotia masanga ya ngayi na pota.

verses.text: Soki monguna na yo azali na nzala, pesa ye bilei ;

continuations.text: soki azali na posa ya mayi, pesa ye mayi ya komela.

verses.text: Pamba te, soki osali bongo,

continuations.text: okotondisa makala ya moto na likolo ya moto na ye,
mpe Yawe akofuta yo.

verses.text: Mopepe oyo ewutaka na ngambo ya nor, ebetisaka mvula,

continuations.text: mpe lolemo oyo etongaka ekomisaka bilongi kanda-kanda.

verses.text: Kovanda na songe ya ndako ezali malamu

continuations.text: koleka kovanda elongo na mwasi oyo aswanaka-swanaka.

verses.text: Basango ya malamu oyo ewuti na mokili ya mosika

continuations.text: ezali lokola mayi ya pio kati na motema ya moto
oyo azali na posa ya mayi.

verses.text: Moto ya sembo oyo asopanaka liboso ya moto mabe

continuations.text: azali lokola liziba ya potopoto
mpe etima oyo ebimisaka mayi ya mabe.

verses.text: Ezali malamu te kolia mafuta ya nzoyi ebele,

continuations.text: mpe ezali malamu te koluka lokumu na yo moko.

verses.text: Moto oyo akokaka te kokonza molimo na ye

continuations.text: azali lokola engumba oyo ebukana mpe ezanga bamir.

verses.text: Ndenge mvula ya pembe elimwaka na tango ya molunge,

continuations.text: mpe mvula enokaka te na tango ya elanga,
ndenge wana mpe lokumu oyo bapesi na zoba ekowumela na ye te.

verses.text: Ndenge ndeke ya moke oyo babengaka mwano

continuations.text: ekendaka bipai na bipai
to mbilambila epumbwaka-pumbwaka,
ndenge wana mpe elakeli mabe ezwaka te
moto oyo asali na ye mabe te.

verses.text: Ndenge fimbu ezalaka malamu mpo na mpunda,

continuations.text: mpe ekangiseli ezalaka malamu mpo na monoko ya ane,
ndenge wana mpe fimbu ezalaka malamu mpo na mokongo ya zoba.

verses.text: Kozongisela zoba te kolanda bozoba na ye,

continuations.text: noki te okokokana na ye.

verses.text: Zongisela zoba kolanda bozoba na ye,

continuations.text: noki te akomimona moto ya bwanya na miso na ye moko.

verses.text: Moto oyo atindaka sango na nzela ya zoba

continuations.text: azali lokola moto oyo amikati makolo
mpe amilukeli makambo.

verses.text: Ndenge makolo ya ebosono ezalaka makasi te,

continuations.text: ndenge wana mpe masese ezalaka na nguya te
kati na monoko ya zoba.

verses.text: Kopesa zoba lokumu ezali

continuations.text: lokola kotia libanga na ebambelo mabanga.

verses.text: Lisese kati na monoko ya zoba ezali lokola etape ya banzube

continuations.text: kati na loboko ya moto oyo alangwe masanga.

verses.text: Moto oyo azwaka zoba to moleki nzela na mosala

continuations.text: azali lokola soda oyo azokisaka moto nyonso na likonga.

verses.text: Ndenge kaka mbwa ezongelaka kolia biloko oyo yango moko esanzi,

continuations.text: ndenge wana mpe zoba azongelaka bozoba na ye.

verses.text: Eleki malamu kotia elikya na zoba,

continuations.text: na esika ete otia elikya na moto
oyo amimonaka moto ya bwanya na miso na ye moko.

verses.text: Moto ya goyigoyi alobaka : « Nkosi ekangi nzela !

continuations.text: Nyama moko ya mabe ezali na kati-kati ya balabala ! »

verses.text: Moto ya goyigoyi abalukaka na mbeto na ye

continuations.text: ndenge ekuke ebalukaka na biloko oyo efungolaka yango.

verses.text: Moto ya goyigoyi akotisaka loboko na ye kati na bilei,

continuations.text: kasi akokaka te kozongisa yango na monoko.

verses.text: Moto ya goyigoyi amimonaka ete azali na bwanya

continuations.text: koleka bato sambo ya mayele.

verses.text: Moto oyo akotaka makambo oyo etali ye te

continuations.text: azali lokola moto oyo akangi mbwa na matoyi.

verses.text: Ndenge moto ya liboma abwakaka

continuations.text: moto, makonga mpe kufa,

verses.text: ndenge wana mpe moto oyo akosi moninga na ye

continuations.text: alobaka : « Ezalaki kaka mpo na kosala maseki ! »

verses.text: Soki bakoni ezali te, moto ekokufa ;

continuations.text: soki bato ya songisongi bazali te, koswana ekokita.

verses.text: Ndenge makala engalaka na mbabola,

continuations.text: mpe bakoni epelisaka moto,
ndenge wana mpe moto oyo alinga koswana
ayeisaka matata.

verses.text: Maloba ya moto ya songisongi ezalaka

continuations.text: lokola bilei ya kitoko,
ekitaka na esengo kino na libumu.

verses.text: Maloba ya sukali ya moto ya motema mabe

continuations.text: ezalaka lokola palata ya mbindo oyo bapakoli
na mbeki basala na mabele.

verses.text: Moto oyo ayinaka moninga na ye

continuations.text: amibombaka na maloba na ye,
kasi atondi na lokuta kati na motema na ye.

verses.text: Ata soki abimisi maloba ya esengo, kondimela ye te,

continuations.text: pamba te makambo sambo ya mbindo ebombama
kati na motema na ye.

verses.text: Akoki solo kobomba makanisi na ye ya mabe

continuations.text: na maloba ya lokuta,
kasi motema mabe na ye ekosuka se na koyebana
na miso ya bato nyonso.

verses.text: Moto oyo atimolaka libulu

continuations.text: akweyaka ye moko kati na yango ;
mpe moto oyo atindikaka libanga,
libanga yango ekozongela kaka ye moko.

verses.text: Lolemo ya lokuta eyinaka bato oyo ezokisi,

continuations.text: mpe maloba ya sukali ememaka libebi.

notes.text: Source note reference 26.2. + Mbilambila ezali ndeke ya moke oyo babengaka, na lifalanse : hirondelle.

verses.text: Komikumisa te mpo na mokolo ya lobi,

continuations.text: pamba te oyebi te likambo nini mokolo ekoki kobota.

verses.text: Tika ete moto mosusu akumisa yo,

continuations.text: kasi monoko na yo moko te ;
tika ete mopaya akumisa yo,
kasi bibebu na yo moko te.

verses.text: Libanga mpe zelo ezalaka kilo,

continuations.text: kasi kanda ya zoba ezalaka kilo koleka nyonso mibale.

verses.text: Kotomboka ememaka makambo ya somo,

continuations.text: mpe kanda ebebisaka ;
kasi nani akoki kotelema liboso ya zuwa ?

verses.text: Pamela oyo epesami na polele ezali malamu

continuations.text: koleka moto oyo aboyi kopamela mpo na bolingo.

verses.text: Bapota oyo molingami azokisi ezali malamu

continuations.text: koleka babeze ebele ya monguna.

verses.text: Moto oyo atondi aboyaka ata mafuta ya nzoyi,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo azali na nzala
ayokaka ata bilei ya bololo elengi.

verses.text: Moto oyo ayengaka-yengaka mosika ya mokili na ye

continuations.text: azali lokola ndeke oyo ezali koyengayenga
mosika ya zala na yango.

verses.text: Mafuta mpe malasi esepelisaka motema,

continuations.text: mpe molingami malamu apesaka toli na motema ya esengo.

verses.text: Kosundola te molingami na yo to molingami ya tata na yo,

continuations.text: mpe kokende te na ndako ya ndeko na yo tango ozali na pasi ;
kozala na molingami ya pembeni ezali malamu
koleka kozala na ndeko ya mosika.

verses.text: Mwana na ngai, zala moto ya bwanya

continuations.text: mpe sepelisa motema na ngai,
mpo ete nazala na eyano ya kopesa
na moto oyo akoluka kotiola ngai.

verses.text: Moto ya mayele amonaka likama na mosika

continuations.text: mpe amibombaka,
kasi moto oyo azangi mayele alekaka kaka wana
mpe akutanaka na pasi.

verses.text: Kamata elamba ya moto oyo alapi ndayi

continuations.text: mpo na niongo ya moto mosusu ;
bomba yango lokola ndanga
soki alapi ndayi mpo na mwasi mopaya.

verses.text: Soki moto moko ayei kopambola molingami na ye,

continuations.text: na mongongo makasi mpe na tongo-tongo,
bakozwa yango lokola elakeli mabe.

verses.text: Mwasi oyo alinga koswana azali

continuations.text: lokola ndako oyo etangaka na tango ya mvula.

verses.text: Kokanga ye ezali lokola

continuations.text: koluka kokanga mopepe to mafuta na loboko.

verses.text: Ndenge kaka ebende epelisaka ebende mosusu,

continuations.text: ndenge wana mpe moto abongaka
soki akutani na moto mosusu.

verses.text: Moto oyo abongisaka nzete na ye ya figi

continuations.text: aliaka mpe mbuma na yango,
mpe moto oyo abatelaka mokonzi azwaka lokumu.

verses.text: Ndenge mayi ezalaka lokola kitalatala mpo na elongi,

continuations.text: ndenge wana mpe motema ya moto elakisaka bomoto na ye moko.

verses.text: Ndenge lifelo mpe mboka ya bakufi etondaka te,

continuations.text: ndenge wana mpe miso ya moto etondaka te.

verses.text: Bapetolaka palata na kikalungu,

continuations.text: mpe bapetolaka wolo na fulu ya moto makasi,
kasi bamekaka moto na nzela ya lokumu na ye.

verses.text: Ata soki otuti moto ya liboma na liboka elongo na mbuma,

continuations.text: liboma na ye ekotikala te kolongwa kati na ye.

verses.text: Yeba malamu ndenge bibwele na yo ezali,

continuations.text: mpe kengela yango malamu,

verses.text: pamba te bomengo ewumelaka seko na seko te,

continuations.text: motole mpe ewumelaka te mpo na libela.

verses.text: Soki bakati matiti ya bibwele,

continuations.text: matiti ya sika ekobota
mpe bakolokota matiti ya bangomba ;

verses.text: bameme ekopesa yo bilamba,

continuations.text: mpe bantaba ekosunga yo mpo na kosomba elanga.

verses.text: Okozala na miliki ebele ya bantaba

continuations.text: mpo na koleisa ndako na yo mpe basali na yo ya basi.

verses.text: Moto mabe akimaka ata soki moto moko te abengani ye,

continuations.text: kasi bato ya sembo bazalaka na mpiko lokola nkosi.

verses.text: Soki kotomboka ezali kati na mokili,

continuations.text: bakonzi bakomaka ebele ;
kasi moto ya mayele mpe ya bososoli ayeisaka kimia.

verses.text: Mokonzi oyo anyokolaka bato bakelela

continuations.text: azali lokola mvula ya makasi oyo ebebisaka biloko
mpe ememaka nzala.

verses.text: Bato oyo babukaka mibeko bakumisaka bato mabe,

continuations.text: kasi bato oyo babatelaka mibeko batelemelaka bato mabe.

verses.text: Bato mabe basosolaka te makambo ya bosembo,

continuations.text: kasi bato oyo balukaka Yawe basosolaka yango nyonso.

verses.text: Mobola oyo atambolaka na bosembo azali malamu

continuations.text: koleka mozwi oyo nzela na ye ezali mabe.

verses.text: Moto oyo abatelaka mibeko azali mwana mayele,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo atambolaka na bato ya loyenge
ayokisaka tata na ye soni.

verses.text: Moto oyo abakisaka bomengo na ye na nzela ya moyibi

continuations.text: abombelaka yango moto oyo asalisaka babola.

verses.text: Moto oyo akangi matoyi na ye

continuations.text: mpo na koboya koyoka mobeko,
libondeli na ye ekomaka nkele na miso ya Nzambe.

verses.text: Moto oyo amemaka bato ya sembo na nzela ya mabe

continuations.text: akokangama na motambo oyo asali ye moko,
kasi bato oyo bazangi pamela bakozwa esengo lokola libula na bango.

verses.text: Mozwi amimonaka lokola moto ya bwanya,

continuations.text: kasi mobola oyo azali mayele ayebaka ye malamu.

verses.text: Tango bato ya sembo balongaka, ezalaka esengo mingi ;

continuations.text: kasi tango bato mabe bazwaka bokonzi,
bato bamibombaka.

verses.text: Moto oyo abombaka masumu na ye abongaka te,

continuations.text: kasi ye oyo atubelaka mpe atikaka yango azwaka ngolu.

verses.text: Esengo na moto oyo abangaka tango nyonso kosala mabe,

continuations.text: kasi ye oyo ayeisaka motema na ye libanga akweyaka kati na pasi.

verses.text: Mokonzi mabe oyo azali kokamba bato bakelela

continuations.text: azali lokola nkosi ya kanda
to lokola ngombolo oyo ezali kolanda nyama ya kolia.

verses.text: Mokonzi oyo anyokolaka bato azangi mayele,

continuations.text: kasi oyo aboyaka bomengo na nzela ya moyibi
ayeisaka mikolo ya bomoi na ye ebele.

verses.text: Moto oyo amitungisaka mpo ete abomi moninga

continuations.text: akimaka kino na libulu ya kufa ;
tika ete moto moko te akanga ye nzela.

verses.text: Moto oyo atambolaka na bosembo akozwa lobiko,

continuations.text: kasi moto ya mobulu oyo alandaka banzela mibale
akokweya na moko.

verses.text: Moto oyo asalaka bilanga atondaka na bilei,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo alandaka bagoyigoyi
akotonda na bobola.

verses.text: Moto ya sembo afulukaka na mapamboli,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo awelaka kokoma mozwi na lombangu
akozanga te kozwa etumbu.

verses.text: Kopona bilongi ezalaka malamu te ;

continuations.text: nzokande ata mpo na eteni ya lipa, moto akoki mpe kosala mabe.

verses.text: Moto ya bilulela azalaka motema moto-moto

continuations.text: mpo na kozwa bomengo,
mpe ayebaka te ete bobola ekokomela ye.

verses.text: Moto oyo apamelaka moninga na ye

continuations.text: akozwa ngolu na suka
koleka moto oyo alobaka maloba ya sukali.

verses.text: Moto oyo ayibaka tata mpe mama na ye,

continuations.text: bongo alobaka : « Ezali na yango mabe te, »
azali moninga ya mobomi.

verses.text: Moto ya lokoso ayeisaka koswana,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo atiaka elikya na Yawe
akotonda na mafuta.

verses.text: Moto oyo atiaka elikya kati na ye moko kaka azali zoba,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo atambolaka na bwanya akokangolama.

verses.text: Moto oyo akabelaka babola akozanga eloko te,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo aboyaka kotala bango
akotonda na bilakeli mabe.

verses.text: Tango bato mabe bazwaka bokonzi, bato bamibombaka ;

continuations.text: kasi tango bakufaka, bato ya sembo bakomaka ebele.

verses.text: Moto oyo atiaka moto makasi soki bapameli ye,

continuations.text: akokweyisama na pwasa mpe akobika te.

verses.text: Soki bato ya sembo bakomi ebele, bato basepelaka ;

continuations.text: kasi soki bato mabe bakomi koyangela, bato balelaka.

verses.text: Moto oyo alingaka bwanya asalaka esengo ya tata na ye,

continuations.text: kasi moto oyo alandaka basi ya ndumba
akosilisa bomengo na ye nyonso.

verses.text: Mokonzi oyo akambaka na bosembo

continuations.text: ayeisaka kimia na mokili na ye,
kasi mokonzi oyo afutisaka mpako ebele
abebisaka mokili yango.

verses.text: Moto oyo alobaka na moninga na ye maloba ya sukali

continuations.text: atielaka ye motambo na se ya matambe.

verses.text: Lisumu ya moto mabe ezalaka na motambo,

continuations.text: kasi moto ya sembo agangaka na esengo mpe asepelaka.

verses.text: Moto ya sembo ayebaka pasi ya babola,

continuations.text: kasi moto mabe ayebaka na ye kutu yango te.

verses.text: Batioli batiaka mobulu kati na engumba,

continuations.text: kasi bato ya bwanya basilisaka kanda.

verses.text: Soki moto ya bwanya akei kosamba elongo na moto ya liboma,

continuations.text: ezala asiliki to aseki, akotikala kozala na kimia te.

verses.text: Bato oyo basopaka makila balingaka bato ya sembo te,

continuations.text: kasi bato malamu balukaka bato ya sembo.

verses.text: Zoba alandaka baposa nyonso ya motema na ye,

continuations.text: kasi moto ya bwanya akangaka yango mpe akitisaka yango.

verses.text: Soki mokonzi akomi koyoka makambo ya lokuta,

continuations.text: basali na ye nyonso bakokoma bato mabe.

verses.text: Mobola mpe monyokoli bazali na likambo moko ya lisanga :

continuations.text: Yawe angengisaka miso ya bango mibale.

verses.text: Mokonzi oyo asambisaka babola na bosembo,

continuations.text: kiti na ye ya bokonzi ekolendisama tango nyonso.

verses.text: Fimbu mpe pamela epesaka bwanya,

continuations.text: kasi mwana oyo basundola ayokisaka mama na ye soni.

verses.text: Soki bato mabe bakomi ebele,

continuations.text: mabe mpe ekomaka ebele ;
kasi bato ya sembo bakomona bango kokweya.

verses.text: Pesa mwana na yo etumbu,

continuations.text: bongo okozala na kimia
mpe akotondisa motema na yo na esengo.

verses.text: Soki emoniseli ezali te,

continuations.text: bato bakotambola ngulungulu.
Esengo na moto oyo atosaka Mobeko !

verses.text: Bapamelaka mosali na maloba te ;

continuations.text: pamba te akososola, kasi akoyoka te.

verses.text: Soki omoni moto kowela koloba liboso ete akanisa,

continuations.text: malamu kotia elikya na zoba, kasi na ye te.

verses.text: Moto oyo alengelaka mosali na ye wuta bolenge

continuations.text: akosuka na kokomisa ye moto makasi.

verses.text: Moto ya kanda amemaka koswana,

continuations.text: mpe moto oyo atombokaka noki
akomaka na mabe koleka.

verses.text: Lolendo ya moto ekitisaka ye,

continuations.text: kasi moto ya komikitisa azwaka lokumu.

verses.text: Moto oyo akabolaka biloko elongo na moyibi amiyinaka ;

continuations.text: ayokaka bilakeli mabe, kasi amekaka te kofunda ye.

verses.text: Kobanga bato ezalaka motambo na se ya matambe,

continuations.text: kasi Yawe abatelaka moto oyo atiaka elikya na Ye.

verses.text: Bato ebele balukaka kokoma balingami ya mokonzi,

continuations.text: nzokande ezali Yawe nde apesaka
oyo ekoki na moto na moto.

verses.text: Bato ya sembo bayinaka moto ya masumu,

continuations.text: mpe moto mabe ayinaka etamboli ya bato ya sembo.

verses.text: Tala maloba ya Aguri, mwana mobali ya Yake. Ezali ye nde alobaki yango epai ya Itieli, epai ya Itieli mpe Ukali :
Solo, nazali zoba koleka bato nyonso,

continuations.text: nazali ata na mayele ya bomoto te ;

verses.text: nayekolaki bwanya te,

continuations.text: mpe nazali na boyebi ya Mosantu te.

verses.text: Nani amata na Lola to mpe akita wuta kuna ?

continuations.text: Nani asangisa mopepe kati na maboko na ye ?
Nani akanga mayi na kazaka na ye ?
Nani akata bandelo nyonso ya mabele ?
Kombo na ye nani ? Mpe kombo ya mwana na ye ezali nani ?
Yebisa ngai soki oyebi !

verses.text: Liloba nyonso ya Nzambe ezalaka na libunga te,

continuations.text: ezali nguba mpo na bato oyo bazwaka yango
lokola ebombamelo na bango.

verses.text: Kobakisa eloko moko te na maloba na Ye,

continuations.text: noki te apamela yo mpe abimisa yo mokosi.

verses.text: Oh Yawe, nasengi Yo biloko mibale,

continuations.text: kopimela ngai yango te liboso ete nakufa :

verses.text: longola mosika na ngai makambo ya pamba mpe ya lokuta,

continuations.text: kopesa ngai te bobola to bozwi,
kasi pesa ngai kaka, mokolo na mokolo, lipa oyo ekoki na ngai,

verses.text: pamba te soki natondi makasi,

continuations.text: nakoki kowangana Yo mpe koloba :
« Yawe nde nani ? »
To soki nazali na bobola, nakoki koyiba
mpe koyokisa Kombo ya Nzambe na ngai soni.

verses.text: Kotonga mowumbu te liboso ya nkolo na ye,

continuations.text: noki te alakela yo mabe, mpe omona pasi.

verses.text: Ezali na bato oyo balakelaka batata na bango mabe

continuations.text: mpe bapambolaka te bamama na bango.

verses.text: Ezali na bato oyo bamimonaka peto na miso na bango moko,

continuations.text: nzokande bamipetoli na mbindo na bango te.

verses.text: Ezali na bato oyo batonda na lolendo

continuations.text: mpe bamonaka bato mosusu pamba.

verses.text: Ezali na bato oyo minu na bango ezali lokola mipanga,

continuations.text: lokola mbeli mpo na koboma babola kati na mokili
mpe bato bakelela kati na bato.

verses.text: Sonzo ezalaka na bana basi mibale,

continuations.text: egangaka kaka : « Pesa ! Pesa ! »
Ezali na biloko misato oyo etondaka te,
minei oyo elobaka te : « Ekoki ! »

verses.text: Mboka ya bakufi,

continuations.text: libumu ya mwasi oyo abotaka te,
mabele oyo etondaka mayi te,
mpe moto oyo elobaka te : « Ekoki ! »

verses.text: Liso oyo etiolaka tata mpe ezanga botosi epai ya mama,

continuations.text: ekotobolama na bayanganga ya lubwaku,
mpe bana ya mpongo ekolia yango.

verses.text: Ezali na biloko misato oyo nasosolaka te,

continuations.text: ata kutu minei oyo nayebaka te :

verses.text: Nzela ya mpongo na likolo,

continuations.text: nzela ya nyoka na likolo ya libanga,
nzela ya masuwa kati na ebale,
mpe nzela ya elenge mobali epai ya elenge mwasi.

verses.text: Tala ndenge mwasi ya ndumba asalaka :

continuations.text: Soki alie, apangusaka monoko ;
mpe na sima, akoloba : « Nasali na ngai mabe te ! »

verses.text: Ezali na makambo misato oyo eningisaka mokili,

continuations.text: ata kutu minei oyo mokili ekokaka kondima te :

verses.text: Mowumbu oyo akomi mokonzi,

continuations.text: zoba oyo atondi na bomengo,

verses.text: mwasi oyo balingaka te, kasi abali ;

continuations.text: mpe mwasi mosali oyo azwi bomengo ya nkolo na ye ya mwasi.

verses.text: Ezali na banyama mike minei na mokili, oyo, nzokande, ezalaka na bwanya mingi :
Bafurmi : ezali bikelamu oyo ezanga makasi,

continuations.text: kasi ebongisaka bilei na yango na tango ya elanga ;

verses.text: bampanya ya zamba : ezali bikelamu oyo ezanga nguya,

continuations.text: kasi etongaka bandako na yango kati na mabanga ;

verses.text: mabanki : ezalaka na mokonzi te,

continuations.text: kasi nyonso etambolaka nzela moko na molongo ;

verses.text: moselekete : loboko ekoki kokanga yango,

continuations.text: kasi ezalaka kati na bandako ya bakonzi.

verses.text: Ezali na banyama misato oyo etambolaka malamu,

continuations.text: ata kutu minei oyo edendaka soki ezali kotambola :

verses.text: Nkosi : nyama ya makasi kati na banyama, ezongaka sima te ata liboso ya nani ;
soso ya mobali,

continuations.text: ntaba mobali,
mpe mokonzi oyo azali kotambola liboso ya mampinga na ye.

verses.text: Soki osali bozoba mpo na komikumisa,

continuations.text: mpe soki ozali na makanisi mabe,
tia loboko na monoko na yo,

verses.text: pamba te kobeta-beta mabele ebimisaka manteka,

continuations.text: kobeta zolo ebimisaka makila,
mpe kotumbola kanda eyeisaka koswana.

verses.text: Maloba ya mokonzi Lemweli, mateya oyo mama na ye ateyaki ye :
Eh mwana na ngai ya mobali,

continuations.text: mwana oyo abimi na libumu na ngai,
mwana mobali oyo nalapelaka ndayi :

verses.text: Kosilisa makasi na yo na basi te,

continuations.text: komitika te na basi oyo bapengwisaka bakonzi !

verses.text: Eh Lemweli, ebongi te mpo na bakonzi ;

continuations.text: te, ebongi te mpo na bato minene kotuna :
« Wapi masanga ya makasi ? »

verses.text: Noki te soki bameli yango, bakobosana mibeko

continuations.text: mpe bakokata na bosembo te makambo ya banyokolami.

verses.text: Pesa masanga ya makasi epai ya bato oyo balingi kokufa,

continuations.text: mpe vino epai ya bato oyo bazali kotungisama na motema.

verses.text: Tika bango bamela mpo ete babosana pasi na bango

continuations.text: mpe batika kokanisa lisusu minyoko na bango.

verses.text: Fungola monoko na yo

continuations.text: mpo na kolobela bato oyo bazali na makoki ya koloba te,
mpe mpo na kolongisa bato oyo bazanga basungi.

verses.text: Fungola monoko na yo mpe sambisa na bosembo,

continuations.text: bundela babola mpe bato oyo bakelela.

verses.text: Nani akoki komona mwasi ya lokumu ?

continuations.text: mpe akembisaka maboko na ye na mosala.

verses.text: Tango mvula ya pembe ekitaka,

continuations.text: abangaka eloko moko te mpo na ndako na ye,
pamba te bato nyonso kati na ndako na ye balataka bilamba ya malili.

verses.text: Asalaka babulangeti mpo na mbeto na ye

continuations.text: mpe alataka bilamba na ye ya lino ya kitoko mpe ya motane.

verses.text: Asalaka bilamba ya lino mpe atekaka yango,

continuations.text: asalaka mombongo ya mikaba.

verses.text: Alataka lokola elamba : molende na mosala mpe lokumu ;

continuations.text: mikolo ya lobi ebangisaka ye te, asekaka nde yango.

verses.text: Alobaka na bwanya,

continuations.text: mpe lolemo na ye epesaka malakisi na bolingo.

verses.text: Azalaka na bokebi na makambo nyonso oyo elekaka na ndako na ye,

continuations.text: mpe aliaka lipa na bogoyigoyi te.

verses.text: Bana na ye bakotelema mpo na kokumisa ye,

continuations.text: mpe tala ndenge mobali na ye mpe akumisaka ye :

verses.text: « Basi ebele basalaka makambo ya lokumu ;

continuations.text: kasi yo, oleki bango nyonso ! »

verses.text: Bonzenga ya elongi ekosaka,

continuations.text: mpe kitoko ya nzoto ezalaka pamba ;
kasi mwasi oyo atosaka Yawe,
ye nde abongi na lokumu.

verses.text: Bopesa ye bambuma ya misala na ye !

continuations.text: Tika ete bapesa ye lokumu, na bikuke ya engumba,
mpo na misala nyonso oyo asalaka !
